title: 1st Convocation Ceremony 2025 | KPGU
content: Admission Inquiry Celebrating Academic Excellence Convocation Ceremony 2025 Event Details View Highlights 1st Convocation Friday, December 12, 2025 Date & Time Friday, December 12, 2025 From 10:35 AM onwards Venue Krishna Education Campus Varnama, Vadodara Degrees Conferred 1,496 Graduating students Parents & Guests 1,600+ Participants witnessed the ceremony Chief Guest Dr. Pradyuman Vaja Hon'ble Minister, Social Justice & Empowerment, Primary, Secondary & Adult Education, Higher & Technical Education Guests of Honour Shri Balkrishna Shukla MLA, Raopura Vidhan Sabha, Gujarat; Chief Whip - Gujarat Legislative Assembly Guests of Honour Dr. P. P. Pandey (IPS) Former Director ACB, Ahmedabad; Former DG & IG of Police, Gandhinagar, Gujarat Presided Over By Shree Jagdishbhai D. Patel Hon’ble Founder & President, KPGU, Varnama, Vadodara The Hon'ble President, Hon'ble Vice President, Governing Body, Board of Management, and Academic Council of Drs. Kiran & Pallavi Patel Global University (KPGU) solicited gracious presence on the occasion of the 1st Convocation Ceremony. During the Convocation, degrees were conferred upon 1,496 graduating students from various academic programs. The ceremony witnessed the participation of more than 1,600 parents and invited guests, creating an atmosphere of pride, celebration, and academic accomplishment. Convocation Procession The Convocation Ceremony commenced with the formal Convocation Procession, led by the University and Faculty flags, symbolizing academic tradition, unity, and institutional pride. The procession included the Hon'ble President, dignitaries, members of the Governing Body, Deans, Directors, and faculty members. Academic Progress Presentation of Report Prof. Dr. A. B. Chaudhary Hon.Provost (I/C) Following the official opening, Prof. Dr. A. B. Chaudhary presented the comprehensive Convocation Report to the assembly. His address highlighted the university's significant strides in academic progress, institutional milestones, infrastructure growth, and research initiatives achieved over the past few years. 40+ Programs Research Initiatives Invocation Ganesh Vandana गाइये गणपति जगवंदन । शंकर सुवन भवानी नंदन ॥ सिद्धी सदन गजवदन विनायक । कृपा सिंधु सुंदर सब लायक ॥ मोदक प्रिय मृद मंगल दाता । विद्या बारिधि बुद्धि विधाता ॥ The procession was followed by a Ganesh Vandana, presented through a graceful Bharatanatyam performance by the University students, invoking blessings for knowledge, wisdom, and success. Convocation Proceedings Official Commencement Conferment of Degree December 12, 2025 In a moment of great significance, Hon’ble Founder & President Shree Jagdishbhai D. Patel conferred degrees upon all eligible candidates, marking the culmination of their academic journey and the beginning of their professional lives. Official Commencement Conferment of Degree December 12, 2025 In a moment of great significance, Hon’ble Founder & President Shree Jagdishbhai D. Patel conferred degrees upon all eligible candidates, marking the culmination of their academic journey and the beginning of their professional lives. Distinguished Presence Chief Guest Dr. Pradyuman Vaja Hon'ble Cabinet Minister, Govt. of Gujarat ડૉ. કિરણ એન્ડ પલ્લવી પટેલ ગ્લોબલ યુનિવર્સિટી (KPGU)ના પ્રથમ કન્વોકેશન પ્રસંગે, મુખ્ય અતિથિના ભાષણે યુનિવર્સિટીની 2004થી આજ સુધીની પ્રેરણાદાયક યાત્રાને ભાવસભર રીતે ઉજાગર કરી. પ્રથમ ગ્રેજ્યુએટ બેચને ‘પાયોનિયર’ તરીકે બિરદાવતાં તેમણે શિક્ષણને માત્ર ડિગ્રી નહીં પરંતુ મૂલ્યો, જવાબદારી અને સમાજસેવાના માર્ગ તરીકે અપનાવવાની પ્રેરણા આપી. વાલીઓ, શિક્ષકો અને સંસ્થાના નેતૃત્વ પ્રત્યે કૃતજ્ઞતા વ્યક્ત કરી, યુવાનોને ‘આત્મનિર્ભર ભારત’ના સક્રિય નિર્માતા બનવા આહ્વાન કર્યું. Distinguished Presence Guests of Honour Shri Balkrishna Shukla Hon’ble MLA - Raopura, Vadodara & Chief Whip, Gujarat Legislative Assembly, Gandhinagar Addressing the graduating class, Guest of Honour beautifully reflected that their smiles symbolized years of hard work, perseverance, and family blessings. Emphasizing values, lifelong learning, courage, and service to society, he reminded graduates that true success lies in character as much as achievement. Shri Dr. P. P. Pandey (IPS) Former IPS Officer, Ex-DG & IG, Gujarat Police Drawing from India’s timeless wisdom, Dr. P. P. Pandey reminded students that true education cultivates humility, integrity, and service. His address was uniquely delivered in Sanskrit, offering guiding mantras for life. भारतस्य शाश्वत-ज्ञानपरम्परायाः आधारं कृत्वा डाॅ. पी. पी. पाण्डेयः नवस्नातकान् प्रति स्मारयामास - यत् सत्यं शिक्षणं विनयं, सत्यनिष्ठां च समाजसेवाभावं च जनयति। Legacy of Excellence Leadership & Institutional Vision Shree Jagdishbhai D. Patel Hon’ble Founder & President The ceremony prominently acknowledged the relentless efforts of the Founder President in establishing KPGU as a world-class institution. His farsighted leadership, unwavering commitment to academic quality, and aspiration to achieve global standards have enabled KPGU to rapidly emerge as a leading and prestigious educational hub in India. KPGU 2025 Message of Inspiration Blessings from Hon'ble Vice President Smt. Kamalben J. Patel Hon'ble Vice President of the University The Hon'ble Vice President extended her heartfelt blessings to the students, expressing deep appreciation for the sacrifices and dedication of parents. She encouraged graduates to contribute to society with values, responsibility, and pride. या देवी सर्वभूतेषु विद्या-रूपेण संस्थिता। नमस्तस्यै नमस्तस्यै नमस्तस्यै नमो नमः॥ આદરણીય મંચસ્થ મહાનુભાવો, આમંત્રિત મહેમાનો, અમારા વ્હાલા વિદ્યાર્થીઓ અને તેમના ગૌરવશાળી વાલીઓ, તમામને સાદર પ્રણામ. આપ સૌ અમારા KPGU પરિવારનું ગૌરવ છો. વ્હાલા વિદ્યાર્થીઓ, આ દિવસ તમારો છે. જીવનના નવા પડાવમાં તમે આત્મવિશ્વાસ, નૈતિકતા અને માનવતાને સાથે રાખીને આગળ વધો - આવી મારી માતૃત્વ ભાવથી પ્રાર્થના છે. શ્રી સિદ્ધીવિનાયક ગણપતિ બાપા તમને સારું આરોગ્ય, પ્રગતિ અને ઉજ્જવળ ભવિષ્ય આપે - એવા મારા દિલથી શુભ આશીર્વાદ. A Celebration of Success Academic Highlights In the dignified presence of the Hon'ble President, Hon'ble Vice President, Chief Guest, and dignitaries, the degree conferment ceremony was conducted with grandeur. The atmosphere was filled with pride as graduates from diverse disciplines were honored for their perseverance and academic excellence. 33 Gold Medals Awarded 1,496 Total Graduates Graduates Distribution 1,496 Total Engineering & Technology 770 Commerce & Management 356 Medicine & Healthcare 199 Science 167 Arts 4 Conclusion of Ceremony Vote of Thanks Dr. Chirag Nagda Registrar (In-Charge) Expressing sincere gratitude, Dr. Nagda thanked the Hon’ble Chief Guest, Guests of Honour, and dignitaries for their august presence. He conveyed heartfelt appreciation to the parents, faculty members, staff, and the entire KPGU fraternity for their contributions in making the First Convocation Ceremony a grand success. Our Legacy Evolution from BITs to KPGU From a strong educational campus foundation to a globally aligned university identity, this journey reflects steady academic expansion, institutional vision, and a clear progression toward excellence. 01 2004 BITS Edu Campus BITS Edu Campus, a well-established multidisciplinary educational campus, laid the foundation for a larger academic journey rooted in quality education and institutional growth. 02 Evolution Towards Academic Autonomy The campus evolved with the objective of attaining academic autonomy, global relevance, and institutional excellence, preparing the path for a broader university identity. 03 Present Drs. Kiran & Pallavi Patel Global University Established under the Gujarat Private Universities Act, KPGU broadened its academic horizon through innovative interdisciplinary programs, stronger research and industry engagement, and alignment with NEP 2020. 04 Future Future Outlook: Global Collaboration Building on its evolution from BITS Edu Campus to KPGU, the University is poised to expand its global footprint through strengthened international collaborations. With the establishment of Drs. Kiran & Pallavi Patel University (KPGU), USA , KPGU aims to foster joint academic programs, research initiatives, and faculty-student exchange, advancing a unified vision of excellence in healthcare and higher education across borders. The Conclusion Honoring the Past, Building the Future The 1st Convocation was not just a ceremony, but a declaration of intent. As the event concluded, the spirit of KPGU was immortalized through action and vision. Sustainability & Growth The Convocation Ceremony concluded with a tree plantation programme at Durlabh Vatika, symbolizing sustainability and growth, followed by the unveiling of a commemorative stone titled “KPGU - First Convocation 2025.” A Vision for Tomorrow KPGU Varnama reaffirms its steadfast commitment to research, innovation, academic excellence, and globally benchmarked quality education, while nurturing responsible, ethical, and competent graduates for the future.
